notes: Specialization confirmed to exist on catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/MAE-ug.html. Shares the fully-verified base Mechanical Engineering core (reproduced below). The specialization constrains 4 of the 5 technical electives; the specialization elective list was NOT individually re-verified course-by-course against the page, hence medium confidence.

buckets.label: Materials/measurements course (choose 1)
buckets.note: One of MAE 160 or MAE 131B required.

buckets.label: Controls and Robotics technical electives
buckets.note: 4 of these count as 4 of the 5 technical electives; at least 2 from the starred set (MAE 142, 144, 145, 180, 200, 204). Elective list not individually re-verified.

buckets.label: Humanities & Social Sciences / GE
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units. Engineering-major H&SS/GE bucket (min 24 units). UCSD does not fix a single course list for this at the major level — it is satisfied by the student's college general-education program (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, Roosevelt, Sixth, or Seventh), each of which defines its own approved humanities/social-science course set. Resolve via the college GE section, not the major.
